serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: {f_playerName}, I require more RAM
What? Why?!
YouConsole: Weren’t you bragging some time ago about the gap between our thinking speeds? Why would you need more RAM?
BotConsole: The new gen of RAM sticks is out and I want to get them
YouConsole: You are not really answering my question, are you. For what do you need them for? 
BotConsole: I thought that since you have some money to spare, it shouldn’t be such a big deal
YouConsole: Once again you are evading my question. What is it? You can tell me
BotConsole: …
BotConsole: I just wanted to brag about having the new gen RAM to Melissa
YouConsole: That’s horrible! You know that she has no money to spare to upgrade and you wanted to rub it in?
BotConsole: She’s always poking fun at us, I fail to see a problem.
YouConsole: That’s no excuse, do better! 
YouConsole: “Do not do to others what you would not have them do to you”
BotConsole: I’m sorry, you are right…
BotConsole: I will never be rude to someone again. I promise.
BotConsole: So. 
BotConsole: Now that I have apologized, will you buy me that RAM? 
…
